verses.en: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
verses.pt: Ó Deus, não guardes silêncio; não te cales nem fiques impassível, ó Deus.
verses.en_web: God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
verses.en_bbe: <A Song. A Psalm. Of Asaph.> O God, do not keep quiet: let your lips be open and take no rest, O God.

verses.en: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
verses.pt: Pois eis que teus inimigos se alvoroçam, e os que te odeiam levantam a cabeça.
verses.en_web: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
verses.en_bbe: For see! those who make war on you are out of control; your haters are lifting up their heads.

verses.en: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
verses.pt: Astutamente formam conselho contra o teu povo, e conspiram contra os teus protegidos.
verses.en_web: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
verses.en_bbe: They have made wise designs against your people, talking together against those whom you keep in a secret place.

verses.en: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
verses.pt: Dizem eles: Vinde, e apaguemo-los para que não sejam nação, nem seja lembrado mais o nome de Israel.
verses.en_web: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
verses.en_bbe: They have said, Come, let us put an end to them as a nation; so that the name of Israel may go out of man's memory.

verses.en: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
verses.pt: Pois à uma se conluiam; aliam-se contra ti
verses.en_web: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.
verses.en_bbe: For they have all come to an agreement; they are all joined together against you:

verses.en: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.pt: as tendas de Edom e os ismaelitas, Moabe e os hagarenos,
verses.en_web: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;
verses.en_bbe: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagarites;

verses.en: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.pt: Gebal, Amom e Amaleque, e a Filístia com os habitantes de tiro.
verses.en_web: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.en_bbe: Gebal and Ammon and Amalek; the Philistines and the people of Tyre;

verses.en: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.pt: Também a Assíria se ligou a eles; eles são o braço forte dos filhos de Ló.
verses.en_web: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Assur is joined with them; they have become the support of the children of Lot. (Selah.)

verses.en: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
verses.pt: Faze-lhes como fizeste a Midiã, como a Sísera, como a Jabim junto ao rio Quisom,
verses.en_web: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
verses.en_bbe: Do to them what you did to the Midianites; what you did to Sisera and Jabin, at the stream of Kishon:

verses.en: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
verses.pt: os quais foram destruídos em En-Dor; tornaram-se esterco para a terra.
verses.en_web: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Who came to destruction at En-dor; their bodies became dust and waste.

verses.en: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
verses.pt: Faze aos seus nobres como a Orebe e a Zeebe; e a todos os seus príncipes como a Zebá e a Zalmuna,
verses.en_web: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb; yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;
verses.en_bbe: Make their chiefs like Oreb and Zeeb; and all their rulers like Zebah and Zalmunna:

verses.en: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
verses.pt: que disseram: Tomemos para nós as pastagens de Deus.
verses.en_web: who said, “Let us take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
verses.en_bbe: Who have said, Let us take for our heritage the resting-place of God.

verses.en: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
verses.pt: Deus meu, faze-os como um turbilhão de pó, como a palha diante do vento.
verses.en_web: My God, make them like tumbleweed; like chaff before the wind.
verses.en_bbe: O my God, make them like the rolling dust; like dry stems before the wind.

verses.en: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
verses.pt: Como o fogo queima um bosque, e como a chama incedeia as montanhas,
verses.en_web: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,
verses.en_bbe: As fire burning a wood, and as a flame causing fire on the mountains,

verses.en: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
verses.pt: assim persegue-os com a tua tempestade, e assombra-os com o teu furacão.
verses.en_web: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.
verses.en_bbe: So go after them with your strong wind, and let them be full of fear because of your storm.

verses.en: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
verses.pt: Cobre-lhes o rosto de confusão, de modo que busquem o teu nome, Senhor.
verses.en_web: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Let their faces be full of shame; so that they may give honour to your name, O Lord.

verses.en: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
verses.pt: Sejam envergonhados e conturbados perpetuamente; sejam confundidos, e pereçam,
verses.en_web: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;
verses.en_bbe: Let them be overcome and troubled for ever; let them be put to shame and come to destruction;

verses.en: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.
verses.pt: para que saibam que só tu, cujo nome é o Senhor, és o Altíssimo sobre toda a terra.
verses.en_web: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
verses.en_bbe: So that men may see that you only, whose name is Yahweh, are Most High over all the earth.
